text:
alex_p: Quick thread — need a product decision on BYOK vs Redwood-managed KMS with escrow + audit log retention for enterprise customers. TL;DR: customers ask for BYOK, legal/infosec pushing for escrow in some regulated deals. Need launch criteria and scope for Q2.

maya_s: Agreed. BYOK should be baseline. Escrow is a different risk vector (custody, access controls). For SOC2/ISO we also need clear retention windows and proof of chain-of-custody.

dave_eng: Technical notes: BYOK via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault is straightforward (connectors + token exchange). Escrow implies HSM integration + secure transfer flows + key wrapping — nontrivial. Rough estimate: BYOK + audit logs MVP = 6–8 sprints across teams; escrow adds 3–4 more.

katie_legal: From legal: escrow can be accepted if we include split-access controls + contractual guarantees. Also need a legal-hold API and exportable audit artifacts for e-discovery.

oliver_sales: We have 3 active RFPs asking for BYOK; 1 large prospect specifically asked about escrow in MSA. If escrow is Q3 we can still keep pipeline warm.

maya_s: Proposed launch criteria (MVP):
- Customer-managed keys (AWS/Azure support)
- Audit log retention configurable (90d default, option for 365d)
- Exportable audit bundles (JSON/CSV) with chain-of-custody metadata
- Legal-hold flag that prevents deletion/rotation
- SOC2 mapping doc + threat model

alex_p: My counter-proposal for Q2 MVP: implement BYOK connectors + retention UI + export endpoints + legal-hold API. Defer HSM-based escrow to Q3 unless sales escalates. Need decision by EOD Fri so we can scope sprint planning.

dave_eng: Work breakdown I see:
- KMS connectors + auth (2 sprints)
- Audit pipeline + retention policy + archiving (3 sprints)
- Export endpoints + packaging (1 sprint)
- E2E tests + SOC2 verification docs (1 sprint)
We can parallelize KMS and audit pipeline. Risk: storage growth — plan archiving to cold bucket and chargeback.

katie_legal: Requirements from legal POV: retention windows must be tenant-configurable, deletions must be provably irreversible on request (when outside legal hold), and we need MSA language for escrow and key retrieval.

maya_s: Security checklist for MVP: key rotation, KMS RBAC checks, access logging for any key operations, encryption at rest of wrapped keys, and support for customer KMS endpoints in Private. Escrow checklist (deferred): HSM escrow, dual control, notarized transfer logs.

alex_p: Quick vote: BYOK + retention MVP for Q2, escrow deferred to Q3 unless @oliver_sales says deal is time-blocked.

oliver_sales: Confirmed — one enterprise needs escrow in MSA with delivery within 6 months; Q3 works. Others are fine with BYOK-only.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created epic ENC-3124 "BYOK + Audit Retention MVP" and linked initial stories.

alex_p: Next actions:
1) PM -> PRD draft by Mon incl. launch criteria + metrics (uptake, time-to-setup, export success rate).
2) Eng -> spike KMS connector proof-of-concept by Wed.
3) Security + Legal -> draft escrow security policy + MSA language for review.
4) Sales -> surface any deals that are hard blockers.
I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu to lock scope.

katie_legal: I'll start MSA paragraph + legal-hold wording and post a doc link here when ready.

dave_eng: I'll create the tech-spec RFC and tag infra/security for review.

maya_s: I'll draft the threat model + security checklist and attach to RFC.

alex_p: Thanks team :thumbsup:
